Your settings keep what a newer version saved.
Closing the panel right as it opens leaves nothing running.

Shortcut keys in tooltips are a little bigger.
Buttons in Settings never send a form by accident.
Tidied up inside. Nothing looks or works differently.
In Hardware, names keep their case and you can see keyboard focus on switches and number fields.
Sizes and speeds no longer read 10.0 or 1024 GB.
Clear is red, like the other actions that remove things.
Hardware and Liquid Glass look cleaner: clearer fields, softer edges in Liquid Glass dark, calmer badges and disabled buttons in Hardware.
Follows the style you pick in Settings > Appearance.
Lists and menus show your choice with a soft highlight instead of a tick.
Updated parts under the hood.
Small fixes under the hood.
Small fixes: clearer messages, German numbers written the German way and better screen reader labels.
Icons all have the same line weight.
Titles break more evenly, and buttons with an icon look better balanced.
Uses the font you pick in Tavora's settings.
Switches and drive boxes that are off now say why when you hover them.
Under the hood: newer libraries.
Loads a little lighter: the app keeps only the Latin letters of its fonts.
Dialogs you open with the keyboard appear instantly.
Toasts wait while the panel is hidden or the game is in front, and slide in and out from their edge.
Everything you can set is in one place now: what it shows, which drives and your connection. Open it with the gear at the bottom.
Screen readers read each message once.
Main buttons and badges can follow a theme's deeper button colour.
Small update to the shared look; nothing changes for you here.
Lists, dialogs and settings pages move smoothly.
Small fades and menus follow the shared timing.
Buttons have a little depth and feel pressed when you click them.
Checkboxes, toggles and options animate when you pick them, and folding sections open smoothly.
The drives, connection and apps dialogs have an icon, a short line under the title and a Close button in the corner.
Menus and tooltips open out of the spot they belong to, and buttons dip a little when you press them.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
Turn on Traffic in the menu to see how much your PC downloaded and uploaded this week, this month and in the 3 months before.
The numbers come from Windows, so they count while Tavora is closed too.
The Connection section says how your connection is for playing: Smooth, Laggy or Unstable, and how long it has run without a drop.
All four connection cards fit in one row, and the drops list only shows once there is a drop.
New Connection section: see if you're online, your ping to the router and the internet, lost pings and the speed of your network.
Drops in your connection are listed with the time and how long they lasted, even when the panel was closed. Needs Tavora 0.21.22.
See which apps use your memory: the new button on the Memory card lists them with their RAM and CPU.
Your NVIDIA graphics card now shows its temperature and power use.
See how busy your CPU, graphics card, memory and drives are.
